# Golden Trigger Rifle Club (Golden Trigger Shooting Academy)
> Professional shooting range and academy in Gerugambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Certified instructors train beginners and advanced shooters, including children, in 10m Air Rifle and Pistol.
